data.name: Name the owned routing backend builtin and deprecate the krt alias
data.description_html:
The public backend name krt hides that routing now uses source maintained and built inside kicad-route, rather than a separate patched KRT binary.

Make builtin the canonical and default owned-engine backend name. Retain krt as a deprecated compatibility alias with a stderr advisory. Current help, documentation, generated skills and examples must use builtin. New routing and campaign evidence must identify builtin. Existing state manifests, determinism records, ledger identities and saved corpus entries must continue to work without rebuilding or changing the qualified engine.

Acceptance: focused alias/parser and identity compatibility tests; native route using builtin and deprecated alias; installed CLI/skill deployment; clean pushed main; advisory to active agents after deployment. Preserve historical evidence and external Freerouting behavior.
